newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU forecasts for Italy too severe - de Charette.
newsitem.headline: EU forecasts for Italy too severe - de Charette.

text.p: French Foreign Minister Herve de Charette on Tuesday criticised the European Commission for sending a "negative message" by forecasting that Italy would miss the deficit criterion for monetary union this year.
"I found the Commission's analysis with regard to Italy excessively severe," he told reporters after meeting his Italian counterpart Lamberto Dini at the General Affairs Council.
"The message which is going out is too negative. I understand the Italian reaction. It would have been more positive to recognise the efforts made by the government and the Italian people," he said.
The Commission last week forecast that Italy would have a deficit to Gross Domestic Product ratio of 3.2 percent this year, missing the 3.0 percent target for the single currency.
Only Italy and Greece missed the target, according to the forecast, which triggered fury in Italy.
